in_sanskrit.name: Jilvitha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jilvitha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jilvitha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Jilva', which means 'leaf' and 'Vitha', which means 'prosperity'. This name is associated with the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. It is believed that bestowing this name on a child will bring abundance and prosperity in their life.
